title: Gemini 3.8 Flash or Gemini 4 Hydrogen: what Google says changes
intro: Switch between Google’s previous fast model and the new one. Each side shows only the figures Google published on 12 November when it compared them.
note: Every figure is Google’s own, from its launch post, and none has been checked independently. Speed is relative: Google says Hydrogen finishes tasks 2.5 times faster at its default high setting, and partners saw 2x to 2.8x faster runs with 12% to 23% fewer tokens in early tests. Google did not give 3.8 Flash’s price or Intelligence Index score in the post, so those are left out rather than filled in. Test on your own tasks before switching.
